استصهنا (form X)
# اِسْتَصْهَنَا (istaṣhanā) /is.tasˤ.ha.naː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَصْهَنَ (istaṣhana)
# اِسْتَصْهَنَّا (istaṣhannā) /is.tasˤ.han.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِسْتَصْهَنَ (istaṣhana)
# اِسْتَصْهِنَا (istaṣhinā) /is.tasˤ.hi.naː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَصْهَنَ (istaṣhana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
